title: 23:4 ashamed. According to Israelite tradition, shame fell on the woman who was barren or violated, or who lost all her children through death. Tyre and Sidon, portrayed as women, will be humbled and shamed. Tyre, referred to as the "strength of the sea," will be virtually depopulated, her people killed, enslaved, or made refugees, and therefore unable to raise up a new generation of young men and virgins to populate the island.
author: Tina M. Peterson
